_source: The target and probe are bergamot-translator output (Mozilla models, 2026-09-10) for the fixture books and videos and for Tatoeba sentences (CC BY 2.0 FR); the words are dict/<code>.db lookups (Wiktionary via kaikki.org, CC BY-SA 4.0), trimmed to four hits of three senses as lib/lookup.py returns them.

cases.why: WORD ORDER: a Persian time phrase opens its sentence and ends the English one
cases.sentence: امروز صبح به سگ غذا دادی؟

cases.target: One day, Chris found the beautiful daughter of his dreams.

senses: a female given name, Roya, from Arabic

cases.why: a Chinese particle (的) does not mark "clear" through its first-ranked homograph

cases.target: She was beautiful and clear, and the best thing was that she was a very kind person.
